name: Find OOX-09/HL!
summary: Near Skulk Rock, a homing robot lies crashed in the Hinterlands. Its gnomish maker, Oglethorpe Obnoticus, calls through a metal egg and asks you to carry a beacon to the wreck.

sections.title: A Crackling Call
sections.body: Turn the knob on the strange metal egg, and a gnomish device opens. A crackling voice gives the name Oglethorpe Obnoticus. His homing robot has crashed, and he has worked out where it came down: where the river begins, near Skulk Rock. Carry the beacon there.

sections.title: The Wreckage at the River
sections.body: At the river's head, you find wreckage shaped like a robotic chicken. Oglethorpe Obnoticus confirms that it is his homing robot. It needs a jump start before it can return to Booty Bay for repairs. Place the beacon inside.

faq.q: Who is speaking through the distress beacon?
faq.answer: A gnome named Oglethorpe Obnoticus is speaking through the distress beacon. His homing robot has crashed in the Hinterlands.
The robot crashed where the river begins, near Skulk Rock in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What does the homing robot look like?
faq.answer: The wreck looks like a robotic chicken.

aliases: what to do with the beacon
faq.answer: The beacon goes inside the robot to give it the jump start it needs to return to Booty Bay for repairs.
